questions.key_step: Tangent length from tan(theta/2)=r/PA; area ratio PA^2/r^2
questions.justification: Two-step standard tangent geometry plus half-angle formula; one familiar move chained with a trig identity.

questions.key_step: Perpendicular tangents in slope form; difference factorises as (m1-m2)(x+3)
questions.justification: Two different parabolas, so the usual directrix result does not apply; the elimination with m1m2=-1 and spotting the factor is the key. Similar demand to perpendicular tangents with t1t2=-1.

questions.key_step: Midpoint of PN gives tan(phi)=tan(theta)/2, or direct parametrisation
questions.justification: Routine locus; a couple of lines of algebra once P=(2t,t) is chosen.

questions.key_step: Normal direction at 15 or 75 degrees; both lines qualify
questions.justification: Routine two-case trigonometric set-up; both A and B correct, slight care needed.

questions.key_step: Area ratio equation 12m^2=|(3m+1)(4-m)|; both signs
questions.justification: Long exact algebra (determinant) with two sign cases and a quadratic; options allow checking.

questions.key_step: Reflection in y=x swaps x and y
questions.justification: One familiar move.

questions.key_step: A on y-axis => equal y-intercepts => lambda=2; HC perpendicular to AB; tangent from C
questions.justification: Four stages (lambda, A, C by orthocentre, tangent to parabola and contact point) each routine.

questions.key_step: (1/a+1/b)=1/2 => (2,2) lies on the line
questions.justification: One familiar fixed-point observation.

questions.key_step: Original triangle (0,2),(0,0),(2,0); incentre; parabola through D; focus
questions.justification: Chain: recover vertices from mid-points, incentre, parabola, focus with irrational numbers; routine but several steps.

questions.key_step: Homogenise with the chord; choose the obtuse angle
questions.justification: Homogenisation is a standard coaching tool; the obtuse/acute choice is the trap.

questions.key_step: Normal cubic m(m^2-2(a-1))=0 requires a>1
questions.justification: Standard normals-through-a-point result, little computation.

questions.key_step: Contact points 2*sqrt(rs) apart on the common tangent
questions.justification: The distance-between-contact-points idea plus three equations and a combination step; moderately familiar.

questions.key_step: e=sec(theta)>2 and monotone latus rectum
questions.justification: Two routine steps, one monotonicity argument.

questions.key_step: 3+4m divides 5
questions.justification: Short divisibility step after solving for x.

questions.key_step: Chord length 2sqrt(r^2-d^2), range n<=5, sum of squares
questions.justification: Routine multi-step with one range check.

questions.key_step: Tangent, normal, circle on AB as diameter, tangents at P,Q
questions.justification: Long chain (tangent, normal, circle, intersection, tangents, intersection) of routine steps; heavy but standard.

questions.key_step: Intercept formulas g^2-c, f^2-c then condition of tangency
questions.justification: Routine chain of standard formulas.

questions.key_step: Incentre of right triangle (rho,rho), r^2=2rho^2
questions.justification: Tangent, intercepts, incentre: three routine steps.

questions.key_step: Intercept form of the chord; distance from origin; sum k+k^2
questions.justification: Short chain ending in standard sums.

questions.key_step: Centres of four circles form a square
questions.justification: One familiar move (centres, then side/diagonal check).
